name: dcp_lse_combine
description: dcp_lse_combine(recv_output, recv_lse, is_lse_base_on_e, return_lse) -> (out, out_lse). recv_output has shape [n, b, h, d] and recv_lse has shape [n, b, h], with n the leading shard axis. NaN or +inf LSE values are treated as -inf; then m = max over shards. The shard weights are exp(recv_lse - m) when is_lse_base_on_e is true, otherwise exp2(recv_lse - m). out[b, h, d] is the fp32 weighted average of recv_output over shards, cast to recv_output.dtype. When return_lse is true, out_lse is log(weight_sum) + m or log2(weight_sum) + m, cast to recv_lse.dtype; when false, out_lse is None. If all shards are ignored, the zero weight sum produces the reference's zero-denominator behavior. Returns new tensors and does not mutate the inputs.
